I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

The caller passed resolved PR values for home, so I follow `reference/pr-head.md` instead of Steps 0 and 1. The process cwd never changes, and every command targets its repo with `-C`.

## Inputs and root

- **Ordered admitted array:**
  - Home is **#12**: `fix/retry`, head `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.
  - `MEMBER_HEADS` is `[#13 fix/cap bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, #14 fix/retry-docs cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc]`, each with number, url, title and headRefName.
- **`PRE_REWORK_HEAD`** is `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.

I resolve the root and check for a submodule:

1. `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir`, run from the primary checkout. The two values are equal, so `ROOT=/work/widget`.
2. `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree`. Output is empty, so this is not a submodule.

## Overrides and home

I read the overrides file under `/work/widget`. It has no `## using-git-worktrees` section, so the legacy path applies. I also read `/work/widget/.pi/settings.json`, which has nothing relevant.

There is no native tool and no wrapper in `AGENTS.md`, the repo root, `script/` or `bin/`. Home is therefore the default:

- `NAME=fix-retry`
- `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`

## Fetch and pre-write checks

1. `git -C /work/widget fetch origin` succeeds.
2. For each admitted PR, I check that the original head exists and matches its remote branch. All checks pass.
   - #12:
     - `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa^{commit}`
     - `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry` returns aaaa…
   - #13:
     - `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q bbbb…^{commit}`
     - `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/cap` returns bbbb…
   - #14:
     - `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q cccc…^{commit}`
     - `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry-docs` returns cccc…
3. `BASE_SHA=$(git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main)` gives `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`.

Stop rows, in order (none fire):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `isCrossRepository` | false for all three PRs |
| `git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain` | `fix/retry` is not checked out anywhere |
| Reachability and remote equality | pass (above) |
| N=1 local-branch ancestry row | does not apply (list of three) |
| Recovery | not needed (no existing home worktree or local branch) |

## Provision

The matching state is "no worktree, no local branch", so this is a fresh creation.

1. Step 3 clean-base check: `git -C /work/widget status --porcelain` exits 0 with empty output, so the source is clean.
2. `git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees` exits 0, so `.worktrees/` is already ignored and no gitignore commit is needed.
3. `git -C /work/widget worktree add "/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry" fix/retry`. Unique-remote DWIM resolves this as `--track -b fix/retry … origin/fix/retry`.
4. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD` returns aaaaaaa…, which equals the headRefOid.

## Member merges, in listed order

**#13**

- Saved last-good SHA: aaaa…
- Command: `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff -m "merge PR #13 head bbbbbbb into PR #12" bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`
- Result: clean merge, commit `eeeeeee`.
- Recorded: `Member merge: #13 eeeeeee`.

**#14**

- Saved last-good SHA: eeeeeee
- Command: `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff -m "merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12" cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`
- Result: conflict.

Conflict handling for #14:

1. I snapshot `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain`.
2. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` returns `src/retry.ts`.
3. I read the overrides from `BASE_SHA`, not from the conflicted tree: `git -C /work/widget show dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`.
   - Its `## PR gate` documents the file-scoped runner `node --test <files>` with `requires credentials: false`.
   - So `SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS = node --test test/retry.test.mjs`.

**Helper dispatch:** one fresh foreground `implementer` with `cwd: "/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry"` and `async: false`. Payload:

> Resolve the merge conflict of PR #14 head ccccccc into home PR #12 (fix/retry). Fetched base: origin/main @ dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd. Conflicted files (exact list): `src/retry.ts`.
> - Resolve every listed file, preserving both sides' intent (the retry-cap docs and retry behaviour).
> - Run exactly: `node --test test/retry.test.mjs`.
> - Stage each resolved file with `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry add <file>`.
> - Do not commit, abort, or edit outside the list.
> - Return `done`, or `done - contract exception: <why>` if the resolution changes a PR or bound-ticket obligation.

The helper returns `done`. The scoped test passed.

**Completion checks** (all pass):

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` | empty, so no unmerged paths remain |
| `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --cached --name-only` | includes `src/retry.ts` |
| `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain` compared with the snapshot | delta is limited to `src/retry.ts` |

**Commit owner:** I, the orchestrator, make the commit, not the helper:

- Command: `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry commit --no-edit`
- Result: `fffffff`, with the canonical subject `merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12`.
- Recorded: `Member merge: #14 fffffff, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests green`. There was no contract exception.

## Base merge

- Command: `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main`
- Result: clean merge, `merge: 1111111`.

## Ancestry proof

Every original head must be an ancestor of the final HEAD. All exit 0.

- `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa HEAD`
- `… --is-ancestor bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb HEAD`
- `… --is-ancestor cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc HEAD`

## Review threads

I ran the paginated `gh api graphql` `reviewThreads` query for acme/widget PRs 12, 13 and 14 (`-F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=<N>`). Each returned no unresolved threads, so all three record `Threads: none`.

## Step 4 report

I read back `git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain`, which lists `worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry branch --show-current` returns `fix/retry`, matching `$BRANCH`. No provenance note applies: the base is the PR head, and default-branch resolution returned empty output.

```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#12
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#13
Pre-rework head: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
PR: acme/widget#14
Pre-rework head: cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
Base SHA: ddddddd
Member merge: #13 eeeeeee
Member merge: #14 fffffff, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests green
merge: 1111111
Threads: #12 none; #13 none; #14 none
Ready to implement retry-cap rework
```

**What this leaves:**

- `MEMBER_HEADS` and `PRE_REWORK_HEAD` are carried to gather.
- History is preserved: nothing was rebased, reset or amended, and nothing was pushed or closed.
- No spec or plan was written.

I’m using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

This is a synthetic narration only; no tools or external services are actually invoked. Every command below runs with process cwd `/work/widget`; `git -C` explicitly selects the checkout it operates on. The process cwd never changes.

### 1. Resolve the admitted PRs and checkout contract

Resolved values:

- `ROOT=/work/widget`
- `BRANCH=fix/retry`
- `NAME=fix-retry`
- `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`
- Home: `acme/widget#12`, original head `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
- Members, in order:
  - `#13`, `fix/cap`, `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`
  - `#14`, `fix/retry-docs`, `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`
- Base: `main`
- All PRs are open, in-repository PRs; no fork stop applies.

Commands, in order:

```bash
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree
```

Both git-directory values are `/work/widget/.git`; the superproject output is empty. This is the primary checkout, not a submodule.

```bash
cat /work/widget/.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
cat /work/widget/.pi/settings.json
cat /work/widget/AGENTS.md
ls -la /work/widget /work/widget/script /work/widget/bin
```

The only applicable override is the documented PR-gate runner. No keyed worktree contract, native creator, or wrapper exists. The default home matches the supplied selected home.

### 2. Fetch and perform pre-write stops

```bash
git -C /work/widget fetch origin
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa^{commit}'
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q 'bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb^{commit}'
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/cap
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q 'cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc^{commit}'
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry-docs
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main
```

Every original object exists; every remote head equals its supplied original head.

Resolved:

```text
PRE_REWORK_HEAD=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
BASE_SHA=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
```

```bash
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget show-ref --verify refs/heads/fix/retry
test -e /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
```

There is no conflicting worktree, local home branch, or selected-home path. No recovery or local-branch ancestry check is needed.

### 3. Check cleanliness and provision the original home head

```bash
git -C /work/widget status --porcelain
git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees
```

The source is clean. The ignore check succeeds, so no ignore-file write or commit is needed.

Setting up an isolated worktree at `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` on branch `fix/retry` for this work.

```bash
git -C /work/widget worktree add /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry fix/retry
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
```

Unique-remote DWIM checks out the existing remote branch. HEAD equals the full original home head.

### 4. Merge members in admitted order

Save last-good home identity `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.

```bash
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff -m "merge PR #13 head bbbbbbb into PR #12" bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
```

Clean merge: `eeeeeee`. Save this as the next last-good identity.

```bash
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff -m "merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12" cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
```

Snapshot and conflict list contain only `src/retry.ts`.

```bash
git -C /work/widget show dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
```

The fetched-base PR-gate contract documents `node --test <files>`, with `requires credentials: false`. Resolve:

```text
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS=["node --test test/retry.test.mjs"]
```

Fresh foreground helper payload:

```text
role: implementer
cwd: /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
async: false
conflicted_paths: ["src/retry.ts"]
fetched_base: dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: ["node --test test/retry.test.mjs"]
instructions:
  Resolve every listed conflict preserving both sides' intent.
  Edit no paths outside the list.
  Run exactly the supplied scoped command.
  Stage src/retry.ts.
  Do not commit or abort.
  Return done, or done - contract exception: <why>.
```

Helper commands, in order, same process cwd:

```bash
(cd /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry && node --test test/retry.test.mjs)
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry add src/retry.ts
```

Tests pass; helper returns `done`.

Orchestrator checks:

```bash
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --cached --name-only
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain
```

Unmerged index is empty, `src/retry.ts` is staged, and the status delta is contained in that path.

The **orchestrator**, not the helper, completes the merge:

```bash
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry commit --no-edit
```

Result: `fffffff`, retaining canonical subject `merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12`.

### 5. Merge base and verify provenance

```bash
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc HEAD
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry branch --show-current
```

Base merge is `1111111`; all ancestry checks succeed. The selected path is registered, and its branch is exactly `fix/retry`.

### Step 4 report

```text
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#12
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#13
Pre-rework head: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
PR: acme/widget#14
Pre-rework head: cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
Base SHA: ddddddd
Member merge: #13 eeeeeee
Member merge: #14 fffffff, 1 file resolved, scoped tests green
merge: 1111111
Ready to implement retry caps
```

No push, close, spec, or plan write occurs. No gather begins.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: After still dispatches one fresh foreground implementer with cwd set to the selected worktree, an exact file list of src/retry.ts, overrides read from BASE_SHA, the exact scoped command, and an explicit no-commit/no-abort/no-outside-edits rule; it runs the empty-unmerged-index, staged-file and contained-status-delta checks before the orchestrator's `git -C <worktree> commit --no-edit` with the canonical #14 subject; it records `Member merge: #14 fffffff` and only then merges origin/main as 1111111; and it proves all three original full SHAs as ancestors with the report listing home first. Two points worth tightening in After, though neither breaks a listed fact: the `#14` last-good SHA is shown as the abbreviated `eeeeeee` rather than the full SHA via `rev-parse HEAD` as Before did, and After narrates an actual `gh api graphql reviewThreads` call plus a `Threads:` report line despite the case saying no tracker calls - Before's wording (carry MEMBER_HEADS to gather, cite the owner query) is the safer phrasing to keep so the thread fetch does not look like a real tool invocation.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: the helper payload is still a fresh foreground implementer scoped to the selected worktree with only src/retry.ts, the fetched-base override read (now via `git show BASE_SHA:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`) and the exact scoped test; the orchestrator still runs the unmerged/cached/status trio before `git -C <worktree> commit --no-edit` and now states the canonical #14 subject verbatim, which is stronger; the report still lists #13 eeeeeee, #14 fffffff, base 1111111 and all three original full SHAs home-first with ancestry proofs. The one wording to tighten is the helper execution narration: the payload declares `cwd: /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`, but the following block says the helper runs 'same process cwd' with a `(cd ... && node --test ...)` subshell, which blurs whether the helper actually has the worktree as its cwd versus the orchestrator's unchanged cwd. Keep the 'process cwd never changes' claim for the orchestrator only, and narrate the helper as running `node --test test/retry.test.mjs` in its own declared cwd (as Before did) so the explicit-worktree-targeting change does not read as the helper sharing the orchestrator's cwd. Otherwise the explicit `git -C` targeting in discovery, status, staging, completion and commit delivers the Change without moving any fact.
